scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Test access is distinct from production; developer token and access-level review generally apply.

app.note: OAuth is necessary but insufficient; verify developer-token access level and current Cloud-managed pilot rules.

app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
